builds.label: Vision scope state decoded at the boundary
builds.summary: VexLifeVisionFamily decodes the service's scope state once, at the boundary, instead of the service comparing raw strings.

builds.label: Keyed elements named from their owners
builds.summary: Workspace and release-alert dataKeys come from an owner registry in main source, and Screen Lens elements are named by their keys.

builds.label: Typed refs and owner constants in the browser runtime
builds.summary: The browser runtime finds typed elements by their Blueprint ref and compares owner constants instead of copied strings.

builds.label: Traditional Chinese as its own screen language
builds.summary: zh-Hant is a screen language of its own, so a reader of Traditional Chinese never sees a Simplified screen.

builds.label: Complete workspace text; complete languages only
builds.summary: Workspace and release-alert text in all eleven screen languages, and only complete languages are served.

builds.label: Two language choices, one Family
builds.summary: The screen language is its own Home choice beside Vex's reply language; VexLifeLanguageFamily owns how the two move.

builds.label: Design foundation aligned with Vextreme v2
builds.summary: Vextreme Design Foundation v2 tokens, both themes authored, and the relationship legend as quiet rails (presentation only; the graph should not move).

builds.label: Everything Claude changed, merged once
